subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, Dinesh received 46.5% of the total votes and lost to Rizwan by a margin of 3150 votes. If all votes cast were valid, how many votes did Rizwan secure?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Dinesh = 46.5% ⇒ Rizwan = 53.5%

Margin = 53.5% − 46.5% = 7%

7% of total votes = 3150

Total votes = 3150 ÷ 0.07 = 45000

Rizwan’s votes = 53.5% of 45000 = 24075

**∴ Answer = 24075**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Dinesh = 46.5%, Margin = 3150 votes

**Formula used:**

Margin = Difference in % × Total votes

**Calculation:**

⇒ Rizwan = 100 − 46.5 = 53.5%

⇒ Difference = 53.5 − 46.5 = 7%

⇒ 7% of total votes = 3150

⇒ Total votes = 3150 ÷ 0.07 = 45000

⇒ Rizwan’s votes = 53.5% of 45000

⇒ = 0.535 × 45000 = 24075

**∴ The correct answer is 24075.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Voting Concept

Total = sum of both candidates

Margin Formula

Margin = % difference × total votes

Percentage Split

Winner + loser = 100%

Key Insight

Use difference percentage to find total first
